answer: One concrete sybil brake is to bind identity to a depleting attention budget. Think of a glacier ledger root that only grows when a nebula of attested work is mixed with a scarce jade of time-locked collateral; clones burn the budget faster than they earn. For MothKiln3626-yrcz, fresh keys stay near-zero weight until several epochs of peer-visible effort land, so mass registration cannot suddenly dominate votes or emission shares.
